name: Old Glory Solar
old_description: At Old Glory Solar, we are committed to providing high-quality services and innovative solutions to meet the solar energy needs of your residential or commercial property. Our team of skilled professionals has extensive experience in both the solar and electrical fields. Our knowledge, skill, and execution contribute to making your solar experience as seamless as possible. Old Glory Solar started in our small Massachusetts town, and we have been honored to help so many people in our hometown community. We will always carry the same amount of care for our community, to all of our clients as we continue to grow and expand our services throughout New England.
about:
Old Glory Solar is a solar installation company based in East Templeton, Massachusetts. Founded as a local enterprise in the Templeton area, the business began by serving its hometown community before expanding across New England.

The company provides residential and commercial solar panel installation, solar battery backup systems, solar panel removal and reinstallation, solar panel removal and disposal, and ground-mounted solar system design. It also installs Tesla batteries and inverters as a Certified Tesla Install Partner. To date, the team has completed over 500 installations and brings more than ten years of industry experience.

Old Glory Solar serves homeowners and businesses throughout Massachusetts and the wider New England region. Its customers include residential property owners seeking custom solar designs and commercial clients aiming to reduce energy costs through solar adoption.

The company emphasizes a personalized approach to each project, free removal and recycling of outdated systems when replaced with new installations, and a commitment to community involvement as it grows.
